text: German cities have an integrated system of buses, trams and underground or suburban trains (S-Bahn). Tickets are often valid on all of them within one region. Buy a ticket before you board: at a machine, in an app or at a counter. A ticket is checked at random, and if you cannot show one you pay a fine.

On some systems you stamp a paper ticket in a small machine (entwerten) before your first ride. Look for Fahrkarte entwerten on the machine. Local transport is generally punctual, but announcements on stops and in vehicles are in German.
